title: Skills, extracted (who-iris)
description: Candidate terms extracted from every skill's front matter: `name` as the label, `description` as the definition. Generated by folio-assistant-core/scripts/glossary-extract.ts; not curated, and never hand-edited: a person promotes a term by authoring it in a glossary of their own.

terms.definition: How WHO IRIS uses DSpace and qualified Dublin Core — the three identifier systems, MeSH as a controlled vocabulary, bundles, and the containment path. What a later tool needs from a record, stated as requirements it can be checked against.
